affirmations.text: You are awesome no matter what happens today.
One steady moment is all today asks of you.
You showed up. That already counts.
Whatever today holds, you don't carry it alone.
Be gentle with yourself — progress isn't a straight line.
You are held; you can rest in that.
Grace meets you exactly where you are.
